error.message: YouTube не принял cookies. Экспортируйте cookies заново и обновите секрет YTDLP_COOKIES.
error.detail: ERROR: [youtube] jNQXAC9IVRw: Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot. This helps protect our community. Use --cookies-from-browser or --cookies for the authentication. See  https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#how-do-i-pass-cookies-to-yt-dlp  for how to manually pass cookies. Also see  https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies  for tips on effectively exporting YouTube cookies
